entities.name: Slith
entities.description: Humanoids with large skull-like heads formed from rock and/or metal, unique to Mirrodin, brought there against their will.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: Place whose heat incubates the slith.

entities.name: Steel Mother
entities.description: Figure from whose womb goblins believe sliths were banished.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Place deep within which the Steel Mother is believed to be.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Mirrodin goblins who fear the slith.
